events.title: Frankfurt Sunday Flea Market at Schaumainkai
events.description: Every other Sunday, the iconic flea market along Frankfurt's Museum Embankment (Schaumainkai) comes alive with hundreds of vendors selling antiques, vintage clothing, vinyl records, books, retro furniture, art prints, and quirky curiosities. Stretching for nearly a kilometre along the Main River with the Frankfurt skyline glittering across the water, this is one of Germany's most scenic markets. Street musicians, impromptu performances, and food stalls selling crepes, bratwurst, and mulled wine add to the festive atmosphere. A must-visit for treasure hunters and vintage lovers.

events.title: Mainz Cathedral Sunday Mass & Guided Tour
events.description: Mainz Cathedral (St. Martin's Cathedral), one of Germany's most impressive Romanesque cathedrals dating back to 975 AD, offers guided tours every Sunday afternoon. Visitors can explore the magnificent interior with its towering columns, intricate stained glass windows, the famous Bassenheimer Altar, and the tomb of Archbishop Willigis. The 10:00 High Mass features the cathedral choir and organ. Afterwards, climb the south tower for panoramic views over Mainz and the Rhine valley. Free entry with optional guided tour.

events.title: Frankfurt Botanical Garden Open Day
events.description: The Botanischer Garten Frankfurt, part of Goethe University, opens its gates for a relaxing Sunday outing. Explore over 5,000 plant species across outdoor gardens and greenhouses, including the stunning Alpine garden, medicinal herb garden, tropical greenhouse with palms and orchids, and the Japanese garden. Expert-led guided tours at 11:00 and 15:00 explain the botanical collections. A peaceful escape from the city with shaded benches and picnic spots throughout the grounds.

events.title: Mainz Sunday Morning Market Breakfast at Marktfrühstück
events.description: The beloved Mainz weekly market transforms the cathedral square into a vibrant breakfast destination every Sunday. Farmers from the Rheinhessen region bring fresh organic produce, artisan cheeses from local dairies, free-range eggs, freshly baked sourdough bread, and the region's famous Spundekäs (a creamy cheese spread). Local vintners pour glasses of Riesling and Silvaner for an early sparkling Frühschoppen. Live acoustic guitar or jazz duo plays from 10:00. Grab a breakfast platter (€8-€14) and sit at communal tables in the shadow of the thousand-year-old cathedral. A true Mainz institution.

events.title: Frankfurt Zoo Sunday Family Day
events.description: Frankfurt Zoo, one of Germany's oldest and most renowned zoos (founded 1858), offers a special Sunday family program with extended keeper talks, animal feeding demonstrations, and children's educational activities. See the famous Grzimek House with its nocturnal animals, the Borgori Forest primate enclosure, and the spectacular Exotarium with sharks, crocodiles, and tropical fish. The newly renovated elephant park and the outdoor lion enclosure are highlights. Special children's activity stations are set up near the petting zoo.

events.title: Mainz Free Walking Tour — Discover the Gutenberg City
events.description: Join a free guided walking tour through the historic heart of Mainz. The 2.5-hour English-language tour covers 2,000 years of history from Roman Mogontiacum to the modern wine capital. See the Roman ruins, the Electoral Palace, the Gutenberg Museum, the half-timbered houses of the Altstadt, and the iconic Mainz Cathedral. The knowledgeable local guides share fascinating stories about Johannes Gutenberg's printing revolution, the city's role as the capital of the Holy Roman Empire, and Mainz's famous carnival traditions. Tips-based (€10-€15 recommended).
events.location: Meet at Mainz Cathedral main entrance, Markt 10, 55116 Mainz

events.title: Frankfurt English Pub Quiz at O'Reilly's
events.description: The legendary Monday night English-language pub quiz at O'Reilly's Irish Pub in central Frankfurt. Teams of 2-6 compete across eight rounds covering general knowledge, music, movies, history, science, and current events. The atmosphere is lively and competitive with regulars who've been coming for years. Prizes include rounds of drinks and bar tabs. Arrive early (from 19:00) to secure a table as it fills up fast. A fantastic way to meet locals and expats in a fun, social setting. Free to play.
events.location: O'Reilly's Irish Pub, Am Salzhaus 4, 60311 Frankfurt

events.title: Städel Museum Regular Opening — Masterpieces from 700 Years
events.description: The Städel Museum, one of Germany's most important art museums, houses a world-class collection spanning seven centuries. See masterpieces by Dürer, Rembrandt, Botticelli, Vermeer, Monet, Renoir, Picasso, Bacon, and Richter. The collection is organised chronologically, taking visitors on a journey from the Early Renaissance through Baroque, Romanticism, Impressionism, Expressionism, and contemporary art. The museum's spectacular garden hall and the 'Black Square' photography gallery are standout architectural features. Don't miss the modern wing with works by Max Beckmann, Ernst Ludwig Kirchner, and Gerhard Richter.

events.title: Frankfurt Riverside Yoga — Monday Sunset Flow
events.description: Free outdoor yoga session on the banks of the Main River near the Friedensbrücke bridge. Suitable for all levels from absolute beginners to experienced practitioners. The one-hour vinyasa flow class focuses on strength, flexibility, and relaxation as the sun sets over the Frankfurt skyline. Bring your own mat and water. The class runs every Monday evening throughout June (weather permitting). Led by certified instructors from Frankfurt's yoga community. Arrive 10 minutes early to set up.
events.location: Mainufer near Friedensbrücke, 60311 Frankfurt (meet at steps below the bridge)

events.title: Kleinmarkthalle Frankfurt — Tuesday Food Market Extravaganza
events.description: Frankfurt's iconic indoor food market in the heart of the city offers a sensory overload of sights, sounds, and smells every weekday. Over 60 permanent vendors sell fresh produce from around the world — Italian truffles and parmesan, Middle Eastern olives and spices, fresh seafood from the North Sea, artisanal cheeses from the Alps, and exotic fruits from Asia and Africa. Tuesday mornings are especially lively with the freshest deliveries. Enjoy a glass of Apfelwein at a standing table while sampling handmade sausages, pickled herring, or freshly shucked oysters. A paradise for food lovers.

events.title: Mainz Wine Tasting at Weingut am Rhein
events.description: Weekly wine tasting session at one of Mainz's historic wineries near the Rhine riverbank. Sample six premium Rheinhessen wines including crisp Rieslings, elegant Spätburgunders (Pinot Noirs), and the region's famous Silvaner. The knowledgeable sommelier explains the terroir, grape varieties, and wine-making traditions of Germany's largest wine region. Each tasting is paired with local cheese and bread. A wonderful introduction to the world-class wines produced right in Mainz's backyard. The winery's courtyard offers beautiful views of the Rhine at golden hour.

events.title: Frankfurt Jazzkeller — Tuesday Night Jam Session
events.description: The legendary Jazzkeller Frankfurt, one of Europe's most famous jazz clubs since 1952, hosts its weekly Tuesday night jam session. The intimate basement venue has hosted Miles Davis, Louis Armstrong, Dizzy Gillespie, and countless jazz legends. Each week features a different house band that starts the evening, followed by an open jam where local musicians and visiting artists sit in. The atmosphere is electric, smoky, and purely authentic — a living piece of jazz history. Entry is free for musicians bringing their instruments.
events.location: Jazzkeller Frankfurt, Kleine Bockenheimer Straße 18a, 60313 Frankfurt

events.title: Mainz Weekly Wine Tasting at Haus des Weines
events.description: Weekly wine tasting session at Mainz's Haus des Weines, featuring a rotating selection of 6 wines from the Rheinhessen region each week. The elegant tasting room in the historic building near Gutenbergplatz offers a curated journey through Germany's largest wine-growing region. Expert sommeliers guide participants through the nuances of each wine, from the mineral-forward Rieslings of the Rheinterrassen to the powerful Spätburgunders of the Rheinhessischen Schweiz. Cheese and bread pairings included. An essential experience for wine enthusiasts visiting Mainz.

events.title: Frankfurt Open Mic Night at Brotfabrik
events.description: Weekly open mic night at Brotfabrik, Frankfurt's beloved cultural centre in Bockenheim. Musicians, poets, comedians, and storytellers take the stage for 10-minute slots in a supportive, packed-house atmosphere. Sign up starts at 19:30. The crowd is enthusiastic and diverse — expect everything from singer-songwriters and jazz trios to spoken word and experimental electronica. The bar serves craft beers and Apfelwein. A wonderful evening of grassroots creativity and community spirit in one of Frankfurt's most cherished alternative venues.

events.title: Mainz State Theatre — Evening Performance
events.description: The Staatstheater Mainz presents its summer season program in the magnificent Grosses Haus auditorium. One of Germany's leading state theatres, the venue features a wide repertoire from classical plays to contemporary dramas, opera, ballet, and musical theatre. The June program includes a mix of crowd-pleasing favourites and bold new productions. The theatre building itself, with its neo-baroque facade and stunning Art Deco interior, is worth the visit alone. Arrive early to enjoy a drink in the elegant foyer.

events.title: Römerberg Evening Walking Tour — Frankfurt's Historic Heart
events.description: An atmospheric guided evening walking tour through Frankfurt's historic city centre, starting at the iconic Römerberg square with its half-timbered buildings. The tour covers 1,200 years of history from Charlemagne's imperial assemblies to the modern financial capital. Visit the Gothic St. Bartholomew's Cathedral (Kaiserdom), the Paulskirche where Germany's first democratic parliament met in 1848, the medieval Römer city hall with its Kaisersaal (Hall of Emperors), and the ruins of the old city walls. The tour ends as the city lights illuminate the skyline reflected in the Main River.
events.location: Meet at the Gerechtigkeitsbrunnen (Fountain of Justice), Römerberg, 60311 Frankfurt

events.title: Frankfurt Running Group — Weekly City Park Run
events.description: Free weekly 5km group run through Frankfurt's central parks and along the Main River. The run starts from the Grüneburgpark and follows a scenic route through the Palmengarten, the Westend, and along the riverbank to the Friedensbrücke. All paces are welcome — the group splits into fast, medium, and walking-friendly pace groups. The event is organized by the Frankfurt Runners Club and attracts 30-50 participants each week. After the run, the group gathers at a nearby café for post-run drinks. No registration needed — just show up in your running gear. A fantastic way to explore the city while staying active.
events.location: Meet at Grüneburgpark entrance, Siesmayerstraße, 60323 Frankfurt

events.title: Frankfurt Museumsufer — Night Openings at Selected Museums
events.description: Every Thursday evening from May through September, selected museums along Frankfurt's Museumsufer (Museum Embankment) extend their hours with special evening programs. The Museum für Angewandte Kunst (Museum of Applied Arts), the Liebieghaus Skulpturensammlung (Sculpture Collection), and the Deutsches Architekturmuseum (German Architecture Museum) all participate with reduced evening admission. Enjoy the galleries in the peaceful evening light, with fewer crowds. Many museums offer special guided tours, curator talks, or live music in their gardens. A perfect cultured evening out.

events.title: Mainz Biergarten Evening — AmRhein with Live Music
events.description: The popular AmRhein Biergarten on the Mainz riverbank hosts its weekly Thursday evening live music series. Located right on the Rhine promenade, this spacious beer garden offers stunning sunset views over the river and the Mainz citadel. Local bands play acoustic covers, jazz, and folk music from 19:00. The kitchen serves classic German Biergarten fare — Obatzda cheese spread, pretzels, grilled sausages, and Flammkuchen. A wide selection of local Rheinhessen wines and craft beers are available. Family-friendly with a dedicated children's play area.

events.title: Frankfurt International School Choir Summer Concert
events.description: The Frankfurt International School's award-winning choir presents its annual summer concert at the historic St. Paul's Church (Paulskirche). The programme spans classical choral works, Broadway show tunes, contemporary pop arrangements, and world music. The 80-voice choir is accompanied by a professional chamber orchestra. The Paulskirche's exceptional acoustics make this a truly moving experience. A wonderful celebration of musical achievement by talented young performers from the international community. Proceeds benefit local music education charities.

events.title: Frankfurt Main River Sunset Cruise with DJ
events.description: The weekly Friday sunset cruise on the Main River departs from the Eiserner Steg bridge. The boat glides past the illuminated Museumsufer, the European Central Bank, the ECB skyline, and under the city's many bridges. A DJ spins lounge, house, and chill-out music as the sun sets over Frankfurt's famous skyline. The onboard bar serves cocktails, wine, and beer. Open deck on top for the best photo opportunities and the glass-enclosed lower deck for cooler evenings. A magical way to start the weekend on the water.
events.location: Departs from Eiserner Steg, Mainkai, 60311 Frankfurt

events.title: Mainz Friday Night Wine & Jazz at Haus des Weines
events.description: Mainzer Weinmarkt and the Haus des Weines (House of Wine) host a weekly Friday evening wine-and-jazz salon in their elegant historic building near the cathedral. Sample wines from over 40 Rheinhessen vintners by the glass, accompanied by live jazz musicians in the vaulted cellar hall. The sommeliers provide tasting notes and recommendations. Local cheese and cured meat platters are available to complement the wines. The atmosphere is sophisticated yet relaxed, attracting wine enthusiasts, locals, and visitors alike. A perfect introduction to Mainz's wine culture.
events.cost_per_person: Free entry (wine by glass €4-€9, food platters €8-€15)

events.title: Frankfurt Sachsenhausen Nightlife Walking Tour
events.description: Discover Frankfurt's legendary nightlife district Alt-Sachsenhausen on a guided pub crawl that takes you to five iconic Apfelwein taverns and cocktail bars in three hours. The tour explores the narrow cobblestone streets of the historic district, known for its traditional Ebbelwei (apple wine) pubs dating back to the 18th century. Visit the famous Zur Sonne (est. 1775), Zum Gemalten Haus with its frescoed facade, and modern cocktail bars that have sprung up alongside the classics. Each stop includes a welcome shot of Apfelwein or a craft cocktail. The guide shares stories of Saxenhausen's history, from artists' colony to party district.
events.location: Meet at Goetheplatz, entrance to Alt-Sachsenhausen, 60594 Frankfurt

events.title: Frankfurt Schirn Kunsthalle — Current Exhibition
events.description: The Schirn Kunsthalle, one of Europe's foremost contemporary art venues, presents its summer exhibition program. Located on the historic Römerberg square, the Schirn has hosted groundbreaking shows on everyone from Frida Kahlo and Edvard Munch to Yoko Ono and Ai Weiwei. The current exhibition explores a major theme in 20th and 21st-century art with works from international museums and private collections. The Schirn's architecture is stunning — a modern glass-and-steel structure that bridges the gap between the medieval Römer buildings and the contemporary art world. The museum shop offers excellent art books and design objects.

events.title: Mainz Karaoke Night at Deckenheim's Irish Pub
events.description: Mainz's legendary Friday night karaoke at Deckenheim's Irish Pub on the Augustinerstraße. A massive songbook with thousands of tracks in German and English, from classic rock anthems to the latest pop hits. The regular host DJ keeps the energy high and the crowd supportive. The pub's cozy, wood-paneled interior fills up early with regulars and visitors. The bar serves a wide selection of Irish whiskeys, German beers, and cocktails. No cover charge. A Friday night institution in Mainz that guarantees laughter, terrible singing, and unforgettable memories.

events.title: Mainz Saturday Flea Market at Südring
events.description: Mainz's biggest and most popular flea market takes place every Saturday at the Südring area. Over 200 vendors spread across a large outdoor space selling everything imaginable — vintage furniture, retro electronics, antique books, vinyl records, toys, clothing, kitchenware, and collectibles. The market attracts bargain hunters from across the Rhein-Main region. Early birds (7:00-9:00) find the best deals before the crowds arrive. Food stalls serve grilled sausages, coffee, and freshly baked pretzels. A treasure hunter's paradise in the heart of Mainz.

events.title: Frankfurt Farmers' Market at Konstablerwache
events.description: The largest weekly farmers' market in Frankfurt's city centre at Konstablerwache. Every Saturday, regional farmers and producers set up stalls overflowing with seasonal fruits, vegetables, flowers, fresh eggs, honey, artisan breads, cheeses, and cold cuts. The summer bounty includes strawberries, asparagus, cherries, and early stone fruits from the Rhine-Main region. Artisan food vendors offer handmade pasta, olive oils, vinegars, and preserves. A lively atmosphere with cooking demonstrations, live music, and a dedicated children's activity area with pony rides and face painting. The perfect place to shop for a weekend feast.

events.title: Mainz 'Science in the Pub' — Meenzer Science-Schoppe
events.description: Popular monthly science event where Mainz University researchers present their latest findings in a relaxed pub atmosphere. Held at a different Mainz pub each month, the event features short, accessible talks followed by lively Q&A sessions over drinks. June's topic covers recent archaeological discoveries in Roman Mainz (Mogontiacum). Speakers bring real artifacts from excavations for attendees to examine. No scientific background needed — just curiosity and a thirst for knowledge. The event has become a beloved Mainz institution attracting hundreds of regulars. Free entry; first drink included.

events.title: Eintracht Frankfurt Women's Team — Summer Friendly Match
events.description: Eintracht Frankfurt's women's football team plays a pre-season friendly match at the Stadion am Brentanobad. Watch the Frauen-Bundesliga side prepare for the upcoming season with an entertaining warm-up match. The intimate stadium setting offers great views of the action from every seat. A family-friendly afternoon with the Eintracht fan club hosting activities for children including face painting and penalty shootout games. Food and drinks available at reasonable prices. A great opportunity to see professional women's football in an accessible, community-focused atmosphere.
events.location: Stadion am Brentanobad, Rödelheimer Parkweg 31, 60489 Frankfurt

events.title: Frankfurt Opera House Guided Tour
events.description: The magnificent Alte Oper (Old Opera House), one of Europe's most beautiful concert halls, offers guided tours every Saturday. The 90-minute tour takes you through the grand neo-Renaissance building, completed in 1880 and rebuilt after WWII. Visit the majestic Grosser Saal (Great Hall) with its 2,450 seats, stunning crystal chandeliers, and exceptional acoustics. See the Mozart Hall, the opera museum with historical costumes and set designs, and the underground modernist extension. Learn about the building's fascinating history, including its destruction in 1944 and its triumphant reopening in 1981.

events.title: Mainz Basket Club — Regional Basketball Match
events.description: The Mainz Basket Club (ASC Theresianum Mainz) plays a regional league basketball match at the Sporthalle am Gonsenheimer Wald. Watch local athletes compete in an exciting, fast-paced game in an intimate indoor sports hall. The club has a strong community following with enthusiastic local fans creating a lively atmosphere. Concession stand with drinks and snacks. Basketball fans looking for an authentic local sports experience away from the big-league commercialism will enjoy the pure, grassroots spirit of this match.
events.location: Sporthalle am Gonsenheimer Wald, Am Großen Sand 10, 55122 Mainz

events.title: Frankfurt Photography Walk — Skyline & Architecture
events.description: A guided photography walk through Frankfurt's most photogenic locations, led by a professional architectural photographer. The 3-hour walk covers the best angles and viewpoints for capturing Frankfurt's unique mix of medieval and modern architecture. Starting at the Römerberg, the route includes the Main Tower observation deck, the Eiserner Steg bridge (iconic skyline photo spot), the modern banking district, and the Alte Oper. The guide shares tips on composition, lighting, and camera settings. Suitable for all camera types from smartphones to DSLRs. A must for anyone wanting to photograph Frankfurt at its best.

events.title: Mainz Rhine Riverbank Summer Brunch & Flea Market
events.description: Every second Sunday of the month, the Mainz Rhine riverbank transforms into a pop-up summer destination. Vendors set up along the promenade selling artisan crafts, jewelry, vintage clothing, and regional food specialties. The adjacent beer garden offers extended brunch with sparkling wine, fresh orange juice, coffee, and a buffet of regional delicacies. Live brass band music creates a festive atmosphere. Families bring picnic blankets on the grass, children play by the water's edge, and everyone enjoys the panoramic views of the Rhine and the citadel on the opposite bank.

events.title: Frankfurt Palmengarten — Summer Garden Concert
events.description: The Palmengarten, Frankfurt's stunning botanical garden, presents its Sunday summer concert series in the open-air concert shell surrounded by exotic plants and flowering gardens. The afternoon program features the Palmengarten Salon Orchestra performing a mix of waltzes, operetta melodies, and light classical favorites. Visitors can bring blankets and picnic baskets to enjoy on the sprawling lawns. The garden's glasshouses showcase tropical plants, cacti, orchids, and Victoria water lilies. The rose garden is in full bloom in June. Children can explore the adventure playground and the 'Giuseppe' dragon playground.

events.title: Mainz Gutenberg Museum — Printing Workshop for Families
events.description: The world-famous Gutenberg Museum offers a special Sunday family workshop where children and adults can try their hand at historical printing techniques. Using replica Gutenberg presses, participants set movable type, ink the forme, and print their own souvenir page. The museum houses two original Gutenberg Bibles from the 1450s — one of the most valuable books in the world. The exhibition traces the history of writing, bookbinding, and printing from clay tablets to the digital age. Knowledgeable guides bring the story of Johannes Gutenberg's revolutionary invention to life.

events.title: Mainz Children's Theatre — 'Pippi Langstrumpf'
events.description: The Mainz Kinder- und Jugendtheater (Children's and Youth Theatre) presents a vibrant production of 'Pippi Langstrumpf' (Pippi Longstocking), the beloved Astrid Lindgren story. The colourful, music-filled performance brings Pippi, Tommy, Annika, and the horse Mr. Nilsson to life on stage with playful sets, catchy songs, and audience participation. The 75-minute show is suitable for children aged 4 and up. The intimate theatre space in the Mainz city centre puts every child close to the action. A wonderful introduction to live theatre for young children. Themed craft activities available in the foyer before the show.
events.location: Kinder- und Jugendtheater Mainz, Schillerplatz 3, 55116 Mainz

events.title: Frankfurt Monday Night Cinema — Original English Films at Cinestar
events.description: Cinestar Frankfurt am Main shows selected Hollywood and international films in their original English version every Monday night as part of their 'Original Versions' program. The modern multiplex features comfortable seating, Dolby Atmos sound, and 4K projection. Current June releases include major summer blockbusters and acclaimed independent films. The cinema is located in the Hessen-Center shopping complex with ample parking and excellent public transport connections. Reduced ticket prices on Mondays. A perfect evening for film lovers who prefer to watch movies in their original language.
events.location: Cinestar Frankfurt am Main, Hessen-Center, 60528 Frankfurt

events.title: Mainz Historic City Hall Guided Tour
events.description: The Mainzer Rathaus (City Hall), an impressive 18th-century Baroque palace originally built as the Electoral Palace, opens for guided tours every Monday afternoon. The tour takes visitors through the magnificent state rooms, the council chamber with its ornate ceiling frescoes, the mayor's office, and the historic banquet hall. The palace was the residence of the Prince-Electors of Mainz, who ruled the Holy Roman Empire's most powerful archbishopric. The tour covers the building's rich history, its role in Mainz politics, and architectural highlights. An insider's look at one of Mainz's most important historic buildings.

events.title: Senckenberg Museum Frankfurt — Dinosaur Discovery Day
events.description: The Senckenberg Nature Museum, one of Europe's largest natural history museums, features the spectacular 'Tristan' T-Rex skeleton — one of the best-preserved Tyrannosaurus Rex fossils ever discovered. The museum's dinosaur hall is world-famous with complete skeletons of Diplodocus, Iguanodon, Triceratops, and the flying Pteranodon. The 'Cosmopolitodus' giant shark jaw is another highlight. Interactive stations let children dig for fossils, examine specimens under microscopes, and learn about evolution. The museum's new 'Senses of Nature' exhibition explores animal senses through immersive installations. A world-class museum that rivals London's Natural History Museum.

events.title: Mainz Culinary Walk — 'Eat the City' Food Tour
events.description: A guided culinary walking tour through Mainz's historic Altstadt, visiting seven food stops in three hours. The tour samples Mainz's signature dishes — Spundekäs (creamy cheese spread), Weck, Worscht un Woi (a traditional snack of bread, sausage, and wine), Handkäse mit Musik (marinated sour milk cheese with onions), and original Mainzer Lebkuchen (gingerbread). Each stop includes a drink pairing, from local wines to freshly pressed apple juice. The guide shares the history and cultural significance of each dish while pointing out architectural landmarks along the way. A delicious introduction to Mainz's gastronomic heritage.
events.location: Meet at Mainz Cathedral main entrance, Markt 10, 55116 Mainz

events.title: Frankfurt Queer Cinema Night — Special Screening at Mal Seh'n Kino
events.description: Mal Seh'n Kino, Frankfurt's beloved independent cinema in Bockenheim, hosts its monthly queer cinema night every third Tuesday. The program features LGBTQ+ themed films, documentaries, and classics in their original language with German subtitles. The small two-screen cinema with its red velvet seats and vintage marquee offers a cozy, intimate movie-going experience. The on-site café serves snacks, wine, and beer. Post-film discussion moderated by the Frankfurt Queer Film Collective. June's screening coincides with Pride Month celebrations. A cherished community event in Frankfurt's independent film scene.

events.title: Frankfurt Opera: Wednesday Evening Recital
events.description: The Oper Frankfurt, one of Germany's leading opera houses, presents a mid-week recital in its stunning modern auditorium. Built in 1963 to replace the original opera house destroyed in WWII, the venue features exceptional acoustics and a striking design. The Wednesday recital series showcases the Frankfurt Opera's acclaimed ensemble in intimate chamber opera and art song performances. The current program features a selection of Mozart arias and German Lieder by Schubert and Schumann. Pre-show talks (18:30) offer insights into the program. The elegant foyer bar serves champagne and canapés during intermission.

events.title: Mainz Summer Garden Party at Botanical Garden
events.description: The Botanischer Garten Mainz (Mainz Botanical Garden) hosts its monthly summer garden party with extended evening hours. The 10-hectare garden, part of Johannes Gutenberg University, features a stunning arboretum, alpine garden, systematic plant collection, tropical greenhouses, and a beautiful rose garden in peak June bloom. Guided sunset walks, plant sales, and garden-themed craft activities for children are offered. The café serves wine, beer, and light summer fare. Live classical guitar music creates a serene atmosphere. A perfect mid-week escape into nature within the city.

events.title: Frankfurt Table Tennis Club — Open Training Night
events.description: The TTV 1951 Frankfurt am Main e.V. table tennis club welcomes new members and guests every Wednesday evening for open training sessions in their modern sports hall. Equipment (rackets and balls) provided for beginners. Coaches are on hand to teach basic techniques — serving, spin, footwork, and match tactics. The friendly, multi-generational club includes players from casual hobbyists to competitive league players. A fun and accessible way to stay active, meet new people, and learn a sport that combines agility, strategy, and lightning-fast reflexes. Refreshments available at the club bar.

events.title: Mainz Wine Market on the Rhine
events.description: Over 30 regional winemakers present their finest Rieslings, Spätburgunders, and Silvaners along the scenic Mainz Rhine promenade. Wine tastings, vineyard talks, and paired regional cuisine. Beautiful sunset views over the river.

events.title: Frankfurt Maintower Observation Deck — Sunset Opening
events.description: The Maintower, Frankfurt's second-tallest skyscraper at 200 metres, extends its observation deck hours every Thursday until 21:00 for sunset viewing. The public viewing platform on the 55th floor offers 360-degree panoramic views of the entire Frankfurt skyline, the Taunus mountains, the Main River winding through the city, and the surrounding Rhine-Main region. Interactive displays explain the history of Frankfurt's skyline and identify landmarks. The Maintower's restaurant and sky bar serve cocktails, wine, and dinner with a view. The sunset experience is spectacular — the skyline's glass towers turn gold as the city lights begin to twinkle.

events.title: Frankfurt Comedy Club — English Stand-Up Open Mic
events.description: Frankfurt's English-language comedy night at the Orange Peel comedy club in Sachsenhausen. Every Thursday, both seasoned comedians and brave first-timers take the stage for 5-7 minute sets. The crowd is supportive and the atmosphere is electric — you never know who might show up. Past surprise guests have included comedians from the Edinburgh Fringe and German TV. Sign-up for newcomers starts at 19:30. The bar serves a range of craft beers, ciders, and cocktails. A hilarious mid-week break that showcases the vibrant international comedy scene in Frankfurt.

events.title: Frankfurt Museumsuferfest Kick-Off — Friday Preview Evening
events.description: The Frankfurt Museumsuferfest (Museum Embankment Festival) kicks off with a preview evening featuring special night openings at 10+ museums along the Schaumainkai. Museums offer extended hours with curator-led tours, exhibition previews, and champagne receptions. The riverside promenade transforms into an outdoor cultural boulevard with art installations, live music stages, food stalls representing cuisines from around the world, and craft beer tents. Friday evening is less crowded than Saturday, offering a more intimate museum experience. A soft-opening that gives culture enthusiasts first access before the weekend crowds.

events.title: Mainz Cathedral Summer Night Illumination
events.description: The majestic Mainz Cathedral is spectacularly illuminated for the summer night series. Special lighting design highlights the cathedral's Romanesque arches, the Gothic choir, the twin towers, and the famous bronze doors against the night sky. The illumination is accompanied by a sound installation playing Gregorian chants, medieval organ music, and contemporary ambient compositions echoing through the cathedral square. Visitors can walk around the entire cathedral to experience the light design from different angles. A magical, contemplative experience that reveals the thousand-year-old cathedral in a completely new light.

events.title: Frankfurt Silent Book Club — Reading Night at Literaturhaus
events.description: The Frankfurt chapter of the international Silent Book Club meets every third Friday at the Literaturhaus Frankfurt. The concept is simple: bring your own book (any language, any genre) and read in quiet, comfortable company for the first hour. Afterward, those who wish can socialize and discuss their books over wine and cheese. The Literaturhaus, a beautiful 19th-century villa in Westend, provides a perfect setting with its high-ceilinged rooms, creaky wooden floors, and shelves of books. A haven for introverts and book lovers who enjoy reading in a shared, peaceful atmosphere.

events.title: Frankfurt Opera: Summer Night Concert
events.description: The Frankfurt Opera and Museumsorchester perform a special open-air summer night concert in the Opernplatz. A magical evening of classical masterpieces under the stars, featuring selections from upcoming season highlights.

events.title: Mainz Open-Air Cinema Premiere — Zollhafen Summer Series
events.description: The Mainz Open-Air Cinema kicks off its summer season at the Zollhafen waterfront. The first screening of the year features a recent international hit in its original language with German subtitles. Comfortable deck chairs and cozy lounge seating are set up in front of a giant outdoor screen with the Rhine harbour as backdrop. A gourmet food truck serves burgers, fries, and loaded nachos. The bar offers local wines, craft beers from Mainz breweries, and cocktails. Blankets are provided for cooler evenings. A beloved Mainz summer tradition that runs every weekend through August.

events.title: Frankfurt Freßgass Food Festival — Summer Edition
events.description: The iconic 'Freßgass' (officially Kalbächer Gasse and Große Bockenheimer Straße) transforms into a pedestrian-only food festival zone. Frankfurt's most famous restaurant row, known for its high concentration of fine dining, brasseries, and wine bars, moves its tables and kitchens onto the street. Over 30 restaurants offer special street-food versions of their signature dishes at reduced prices. Live cooking demonstrations by celebrity chefs from Frankfurt's Michelin-starred kitchens. Wine stalls from Rheingau and Rheinhessen vintners. Live jazz and soul music on two stages. One of the most delicious days of the year in Frankfurt.
events.location: Große Bockenheimer Straße / Kalbächer Gasse, 60313 Frankfurt

events.title: Mainz Sunset Boat Cruise on the Rhine
events.description: A relaxing three-hour sunset boat cruise on the Rhine River departing from Mainz. The boat glides past the historic Mainz skyline, the Rhine islands, the vineyards of the Rheingau, and the legendary Mäuseturm (Mouse Tower) and Germania monument near Rüdesheim. The onboard restaurant serves a three-course dinner featuring regional cuisine paired with Rheinhessen wines. Open deck provides spectacular photo opportunities as the sun sets over the river valley. Live accordion music adds to the romantic atmosphere. A quintessential Rhine experience that captures the magic of the river.
events.location: Departs from KD Rheinkai, Brückenstraße 1, 55116 Mainz

events.title: Frankfurt Street Art Tour — Exploring the Urban Canvas
events.description: A guided walking tour exploring Frankfurt's vibrant street art and graffiti scene. The 2.5-hour tour covers the Bahnhofsviertel (train station district) and Ostend, where derelict buildings, railway arches, and bridge pillars serve as canvases for local and international street artists. See large-scale murals by Frankfurt's most famous graffiti crews, hidden stencil works, legal walls, and ever-evolving paste-ups. The guide explains the techniques, the legal vs. illegal scene, and the stories behind the artists. The tour ends at a street art gallery where some works are for sale. A eye-opening look at Frankfurt's underground creative energy.
events.location: Meet at Hauptbahnhof Frankfurt, main entrance, 60329 Frankfurt

events.title: Mainz Stadtpark Summer Concert Series — Brass & Jazz
events.description: The Mainz Stadtpark (City Park) hosts its weekly Saturday afternoon summer concert series in the park's historic bandstand. June's program features the Mainz Jazz Collective and the Rheinhessen Brass Band alternating sets of swing, Dixieland, and modern jazz. The park's sprawling lawns, ancient trees, and rose gardens provide a beautiful natural amphitheatre. Visitors bring picnic baskets, blankets, and lawn chairs. The park café serves wine, beer, coffee, and homemade cakes. A beloved Mainz tradition that brings together families, couples, and music lovers for unhurried summer afternoons.

events.title: International Museum Day at Frankfurt Museumsufer
events.description: Frankfurt's Museumsufer celebrates International Museum Day with special events, free or reduced admission, and extended opening hours across all participating museums. The entire Schaumainkai becomes a cultural festival with museums offering special tours, workshops, children's activities, and behind-the-scenes access. Participating museums include the Städel, Liebieghaus, Museum für Angewandte Kunst, Weltkulturen Museum, Deutsches Architekturmuseum, Deutsches Filmmuseum, and the Museum für Kommunikation. A free shuttle bus connects all venues. Special children's passports let kids collect stamps at each museum. An unparalleled day of culture for the whole family.

events.title: Mainz Yoga on the Rhine — Summer Solstice Sunrise Session
events.description: Celebrate the summer solstice with a special sunrise yoga session on the banks of the Rhine. The session marks the longest day of the year as the sun rises over the river. The one-hour gentle flow class is led by experienced instructors and is suitable for all levels. After the class, participants share tea and fruit as the city awakens. The session takes place on the grass near the Rheingoldhalle, directly on the riverbank. Bring a mat, warm layers for the early morning chill, and a blanket for the post-yoga tea ceremony. A beautiful start to the longest day of the year.

events.title: Frankfurt English Theatre — Matinee Performance
events.description: The English Theatre Frankfurt, one of the largest English-language theatres in continental Europe, presents its current production at Sunday matinee prices. Located in the Gallusanlage near the Hauptbahnhof, the theatre produces a season of classic and contemporary plays performed by international casts. The June offering is a critically acclaimed comedy with razor-sharp dialogue and stellar performances. The intimate 300-seat theatre ensures every seat has a great view. Pre-show drinks and post-show discussions with the cast are available. Sunday matinees are especially popular with families and theatre lovers making a day of it.

events.title: Mainz Wine Tasting at the Electoral Palace Cellar
events.description: The historic electoral palace cellars in Mainz host a special Sunday afternoon wine tasting. The vaulted 17th-century cellars, once used by the Prince-Electors to store their finest vintages, now house a collection of premium Rheinhessen wines. The tasting includes eight wines ranging from crisp mineral Rieslings to full-bodied Spätburgunders, accompanied by expert commentary on wine-making traditions, terroir, and food pairing. Local cheese and charcuterie are served between tastings. The cavernous, candle-lit cellar with its ancient stone walls provides an unforgettable atmosphere. Limited to 25 participants — book in advance.
events.location: Kurfürstliches Schloss Mainz (Electoral Palace), Georg-Forster-Straße 3, 55116 Mainz

events.title: Frankfurt Cycle Path Tour — Main River to Offenbach
events.description: A guided group bicycle ride along the Main River cycle path from central Frankfurt to Offenbach and back. The 20km round trip follows the well-maintained riverside bike paths, passing through green parks, under historic bridges, and past the European Central Bank in Ostend. The pace is moderate and suitable for recreational cyclists. A picnic stop at Offenbach's Leonhardpark includes refreshments. The tour returns along the opposite bank for different views. Bike rental available at the starting point (€15 for the day). Helmets provided. A lovely Sunday morning activity that shows Frankfurt from its most scenic side — the river.
events.location: Meet at Eiserner Steg, south bank, 60311 Frankfurt

events.title: Mainz Johannisnacht Festival
events.description: Mainz's traditional summer festival celebrating Johannes Gutenberg. Medieval market, artisan crafts, live music across multiple stages, historical reenactments, and a spectacular fireworks display over the Rhine on the final evening. Named after St. John's Day.
events.location: Mainz Old Town & Rhine banks, 55116 Mainz

events.title: Frankfurt Street Food Night Market
events.description: Monthly street food market at Kleinmarkthalle area. 40+ food vendors from around the world, live cooking shows, craft beer stations, and live music performances. A paradise for food lovers with cuisines from Thai to Mexican, Korean to Italian.

events.title: Eintracht Frankfurt Testspiel (Pre-Season Friendly)
events.description: Pre-season friendly match ahead of the new Bundesliga season. Watch Eintracht Frankfurt warm up against international opposition at Deutsche Bank Park. Great atmosphere for families.
events.location: Deutsche Bank Park, Mörfelder Landstraße 362, 60528 Frankfurt

events.title: Senckenberg Museum: Dinosaur & Prehistoric Life Exhibition
events.description: One of Europe's largest natural history museums. See the famous 'Tristan' T-Rex skeleton, the largest dinosaur exhibition in Germany, plus special summer exhibition on prehistoric marine life. Interactive fossil-digging area for children.

events.title: Mainz State Museum: Permanent & Special Exhibitions
events.description: Landesmuseum Mainz, one of Germany's oldest museums, houses an impressive collection spanning prehistoric artifacts, Roman antiquities, medieval art, Renaissance paintings, and contemporary works. Currently featuring a special exhibition on Roman Mainz (Mogontiacum).

events.title: Frankfurt Kleinmarkthalle — Culinary Market Tour
events.description: Frankfurt's iconic indoor food market with over 60 vendors. Fresh produce from around the world, Italian delicacies, Middle Eastern spices, fresh pasta, artisan cheeses, and Frankfurt specialties. Guided tasting tours available. A feast for all senses year-round.

events.title: Mainz Frühlingserwachen — City Garden Tour
events.description: Guided walking tour through Mainz's most beautiful hidden gardens and courtyards. Visit the Botanical Garden of Mainz University, the Baroque gardens of the Electoral Palace, and private courtyards not usually open to the public. Includes wine tasting at a historic vineyard within the city.

events.title: Schirn Kunsthalle: Summer Exhibition Opening
events.description: The Schirn Kunsthalle presents its major summer exhibition. One of Europe's most prestigious contemporary art venues, known for groundbreaking shows spanning classical modernism to cutting-edge contemporary art. Previous exhibitions have featured Frida Kahlo, Chagall, and Picasso.

events.title: Mainz Summer Lights — Rhein in Flammen
events.description: Spectacular fireworks display over the Rhine River synchronized to classical music. Boat parades along the river, street food stalls, and live music along the Mainz riverbanks. One of the most beautiful pyrotechnic shows in Germany with the illuminated city and fortress as backdrop.

events.title: Frankfurt Art & Flea Market at Schaumainkai
events.description: The legendary flea market along the Museum Embankment (Schaumainkai). Every other Saturday, hundreds of vendors sell antiques, vintage clothing, art, vinyl records, books, and curiosities. One of Germany's most scenic flea markets with the Frankfurt skyline backdrop.

events.title: Gutenberg Museum Mainz — Printing Workshop
events.description: The world-famous Gutenberg Museum in Mainz offers special summer workshops where visitors can try their hand at historical printing techniques. See one of the original Gutenberg Bibles and learn about the invention that changed the world.

events.title: Frankfurt Main River Kayak & SUP Sunset Tours
events.description: Guided sunset kayak and stand-up paddleboard tours on the Main River through central Frankfurt. Paddle past the Museumsufer, Eiserner Steg, and the illuminated skyline at golden hour. Equipment provided, beginners welcome. Available weekly throughout summer.

events.title: Frankfurt City Golf — Urban Mini-Golf on Roof Terraces
events.description: Pop-up urban mini-golf course on a Frankfurt rooftop with views of the skyline. Creative hole designs themed after Frankfurt landmarks. Cocktails, DJ sets, and lounge area. Perfect for a fun evening with friends or a date night.

events.title: Palmengarten: Summer Night Concert Series
events.description: Open-air classical and pop concerts in the stunning Palmengarten botanical gardens. Bring a blanket and picnic to enjoy world-class music surrounded by exotic plants, palm trees, and flower gardens under the summer evening sky.

events.title: Open-Air Kino Mainz — Summer Film Series
events.description: Mainz's popular open-air cinema series on the Zollhafen waterfront. International films in original language with German subtitles. Cozy lounge seating, food trucks, and a bar. Runs weekly throughout July and August.

events.title: Mainz Market Breakfast — Wochenmarkt Frühstück
events.description: Weekly market breakfast on the Mainz cathedral square. Fresh regional produce, artisan bread, local cheeses, Mainz wines, and sparkling Frühschoppen. A beloved Saturday morning tradition. Live acoustic music from local musicians every week.

events.title: Mousonturm Frankfurt: Contemporary Performance Series
events.description: Künstlerhaus Mousonturm, Frankfurt's leading venue for contemporary performing arts. Features avant-garde theatre, contemporary dance, performance art, and interdisciplinary works from international artists. One of Germany's most important independent performance spaces.

events.title: Römerberg Summer Open-Air Cinema
events.description: Frankfurt's beloved open-air cinema on the historic Römerberg square. Watch classic and contemporary films under the stars with the medieval Römer buildings as your backdrop. German and English-language screenings. Bring blankets and cushions.

events.title: Frankfurt Riverboat Party Cruise
events.description: Summer night party cruise on the Main River. DJs spinning house, electronic, and chart hits. Cocktail bar, panoramic views of Frankfurt's illuminated skyline from the water. A unique way to experience the city at night.
events.location: Departs from Eiserner Steg, Mainkai, Frankfurt

events.title: Frankfurt Batschkapp Summer Concert Series
events.description: Frankfurt's legendary live music club Batschkapp hosts its summer concert series featuring international rock, indie, and alternative acts. Known for launching major bands and its intimate, high-energy atmosphere.

events.title: Frankfurt Kitchen Party — Underground Supper Club
events.description: Frankfurt's most popular underground supper club. Rotating location each month (loft, rooftop, warehouse). Multi-course tasting menu by up-and-coming chefs, natural wine pairing, and a social dining experience with strangers who become friends. Tickets sell out within hours.

events.title: Nippon Conn — Germany's Largest Japanese Pop Culture Convention
events.description: Germany's largest Japanese pop culture convention. Anime screenings, cosplay competitions on the main stage, manga artists from Japan, J-pop concerts, traditional Japanese food market, workshops on calligraphy, origami, voice acting, and martial arts. Over 30,000 visitors expected.

events.title: Gibson Club Frankfurt: International DJ Night
events.description: Frankfurt's premier nightclub Gibson Club hosts world-renowned DJs. State-of-the-art sound system, multi-level venue, VIP areas, and a sophisticated crowd. Regular appearances by top international electronic, house, and techno artists.

events.title: Frankfurt Wäldchestag — Forest Day Tradition
events.description: Frankfurt's unique 'Forest Day' tradition dating back to the 16th century. On the Tuesday after Whitsun, the entire city heads to the Stadtwald (city forest) for a public holiday celebration. Food stalls, beer gardens, traditional music, and dancing in the forest. Frankfurter's most beloved local tradition — schools and many offices close.

events.title: Mainfest Frankfurt
events.description: Frankfurt's traditional three-day summer festival on the banks of the Main River. Carnival rides, live music stages, regional food specialties (Handkäse, Grüne Soße, Frankfurter Würstchen, Apfelwein), artisan market, and a spectacular fireworks display over the river on Saturday evening. Family-friendly all weekend.
events.location: Mainkai, along Main River between Friedensbrücke and Untermainbrücke, Frankfurt

events.title: Frankfurt Jazz Festival
events.description: International jazz festival across multiple Frankfurt venues. From intimate club sessions at the legendary Jazzkeller to open-air concerts along the Main riverbanks. Features Grammy-winning headliners, European avant-garde artists, and emerging local talent. Late-night jam sessions every evening.
events.location: Various venues across Frankfurt (Jazzkeller, HR-Sendesaal, Mainufer)

events.title: Frankfurt Dippemess — Traditional Funfair
events.description: Frankfurt's historic funfair dating back to the 14th century. Roller coasters, thrill rides, bumper cars, shooting galleries, candy floss, and traditional fairground games. The name 'Dippemess' comes from the pottery (Dippe) that was traditionally sold here. A beloved Frankfurt tradition for all ages.

events.title: Mainz Wine Market & Regional Food Fair
events.description: Mainz showcases its finest regional wines and cuisine on the scenic Rhine promenade. Over 40 winemakers from Rheinhessen, Germany's largest wine region. Regional specialties like Spundekäs, Weck, Worscht un Woi (Mainz's signature snack). Live jazz and folk music.

events.title: Apfelwein Festival — Frankfurt's Signature Drink Celebration
events.description: Celebrate Frankfurt's beloved apple wine (Apfelwein) in Alt-Sachsenhausen. Sample dozens of local Apfelwein varieties from traditional producers, enjoy hearty Frankfurter cuisine (Handkäse mit Musik, Rippchen mit Kraut), listen to live folk and Schlager music, and learn about the 400-year-old tradition of Ebbelwei.

events.title: Mainz Summer Night Market on the Rhine
events.description: A magical night market on the banks of the Rhine in Mainz. Handcrafted goods, local art, jewelry, fashion pop-ups, vinyl records, and street food. Fairy lights, acoustic live music, and a relaxed summer evening atmosphere.

events.title: Eintracht Frankfurt vs. Bundesliga Season Opener
events.description: Bundesliga season opener at Deutsche Bank Park. Experience the electric atmosphere of 51,500 passionate Eintracht Frankfurt fans. Pre-match fan zone with live music, food stalls, and family activities in the stadium grounds.
events.location: Deutsche Bank Park, Mörfelder Landstraße 362, 60528 Frankfurt

events.title: Museumsuferfest — Frankfurt's Biggest Cultural Festival
events.description: Frankfurt's biggest cultural festival along the Museumsufer riverbank. Over 30 museums open their doors with special exhibitions, behind-the-scenes tours, and hands-on activities. Live music on multiple stages across the riverbanks, international food stalls, dance performances, artist workshops, and a grand fireworks finale over the Main River. Attracts over 3 million visitors annually.
events.cost_per_person: Free (museum entry fees vary €4-€12, combined ticket €20)
events.location: Museumsufer, along both sides of Main River, Frankfurt

events.title: Goethe Museum: Special Exhibition Opening
events.description: The Goethe House museum presents a new special exhibition exploring the life and works of Johann Wolfgang von Goethe, Frankfurt's most famous son. Rare manuscripts, first editions, personal artifacts, portraits, and interactive digital installations.

events.title: Frankfurt Marathon Training Run — City Run Series
events.description: Official half-marathon training run through Frankfurt's city center, organized as a lead-up to the Frankfurt Marathon in October. Run past the Römer, along the Main riverbanks, and through the banking district. Water stations and pacers provided.
events.location: Start at Römer, Frankfurt (finish at Festhalle)

events.title: Mainz Theatre: New Season Opening
events.description: Mainz State Theatre (Staatstheater Mainz) opens its new season with a premiere performance. World-class theatre, opera, and ballet in one of Germany's most beautiful historic theatres. The repertoire spans Shakespeare to contemporary German playwrights.

events.title: Oper Frankfurt: Der Fliegende Holländer
events.description: Wagner's dramatic opera 'The Flying Dutchman' performed by the acclaimed Frankfurt Opera ensemble. A haunting tale of a cursed sea captain condemned to sail the oceans forever, and the woman whose love may redeem him. Stunning set design and world-class orchestral performance.

events.title: Frankfurt English Theatre: New Season Opening
events.description: The English Theatre Frankfurt, one of Europe's largest English-language theatres, opens its new season. International casts perform contemporary English-language plays, classic dramas, and comedies. Pre-show dinner packages available.

events.title: Nacht der Museen — Museumsufer Night
events.description: The legendary Night of Museums across Frankfurt. Over 40 museums open their doors until 2 AM with a single ticket. Special guided tours by candlelight, live performances in every museum, experimental art installations, cocktail bars, DJ sets in gallery spaces, and shuttle buses connecting all venues. A cultural marathon.
events.cost_per_person: €15 (one ticket for all museums, includes shuttle bus)
events.location: All participating museums across Frankfurt (Museumsufer, Innenstadt, Bockenheim)

events.title: Frankfurt Opera: New Season Opening Gala
events.description: Gala opening night of the Frankfurt Opera's new season. Black-tie event with a special program featuring highlights from the upcoming repertoire. Pre-show champagne reception in the foyer. One of Frankfurt's most glamorous cultural events.

events.title: Mainz Wine Autumn — Harvest Festival
events.description: Celebrate the grape harvest season in Mainz. Wine tastings of the new vintage, traditional Federweißer (young wine), Zwiebelkuchen (onion tart), and chestnut roasts. Live folk music, vineyard walks, and wine-growing demonstrations. Set along the autumn-coloured Rhine.

events.title: Frankfurter Buchmesse — World's Largest Book Fair
events.description: One of the world's largest and most prestigious book fairs. Meet authors, publishers, and literary agents from 100+ countries. Author readings, panel discussions, book signings, and special exhibitions. Guest of Honour country pavilion with cultural program. Public days on the weekend are a paradise for book lovers.

events.title: Frankfurt Marathon
events.description: One of Germany's largest city marathons through the streets of Frankfurt. Starts at the Festhalle, past the banking towers, along the Main riverbanks, through Sachsenhausen and the city centre. Live music at every kilometre. Charity relay teams, inline skating马拉松, and family fun run also available.

events.title: Jazzkeller Frankfurt: November Jazz Series
events.description: Frankfurt's legendary Jazzkeller, one of Europe's most famous jazz clubs since 1952, presents its November concert series. Intimate basement venue that has hosted Miles Davis, Louis Armstrong, and Dizzy Gillespie. Features international touring artists and local talent. Late-night jam sessions after every concert.
events.location: Jazzkeller Frankfurt, Kleine Bockenheimer Straße 18a, 60313 Frankfurt

events.title: Frankfurt Christmas Market on Römerberg
events.description: One of Germany's oldest and most beautiful Christmas markets, dating back to 1393. Over 200 wooden stalls fill the Römerberg and Paulsplatz with handcrafted gifts, Christmas decorations, mulled wine (Glühwein), roasted almonds, candied fruits, and traditional Frankfurter Bethmännchen marzipan cookies. The giant Christmas tree in front of the Römer and the nightly light show make it magical.

events.title: Mainz Christmas Market
events.description: Mainz's charming Christmas market on the cathedral square. Over 100 stalls, an ice-skating rink in front of the majestic Mainz Cathedral, live nativity scene, children's craft workshops, and the famous Mainzer Glühwein. Historic carousel and weekly choir performances in the cathedral.
events.cost_per_person: Free entry (ice skating €6 incl. skate rental)

events.title: Mainz Carnival — Rosenmontag Parade
events.description: Mainz is one of Germany's three main carnival strongholds (alongside Cologne and Düsseldorf). The Mainz Rosenmontag parade features elaborately decorated floats, marching bands, costumed groups throwing sweets and flowers to the crowds. Carnival sessions (Sitzungen) with comedic speeches and performances run from November through February.
events.location: Mainz city centre (parade route along Große Bleiche, Schillerplatz, and around the Altstadt)

events.title: Frankfurt Ballet: The Nutcracker
events.description: Frankfurt Ballet's enchanting production of Tchaikovsky's The Nutcracker at the Oper Frankfurt. A magical Christmas tradition for the whole family with stunning choreography, elaborate costumes, and a live orchestra performing the beloved score.

events.title: Jahrhunderthalle: Christmas Gala Concert
events.description: Festive Christmas gala concert at the historic Jahrhunderthalle Frankfurt. World-class orchestra, choir, and soloists perform classical Christmas masterpieces, traditional carols, and seasonal favorites. A highlight of Frankfurt's Christmas season.

events.title: Frankfurt Zoo: Winter Wonderland Light Trail
events.description: Frankfurt Zoo transforms into a winter wonderland with thousands of lights, illuminated animal sculptures, and a magical light trail through the grounds. Hot chocolate and roasted chestnuts available. A magical post-Christmas family outing.

events.title: New Year's Eve at Frankfurt Römer
events.description: Spectacular New Year's Eve celebration on Frankfurt's Römerberg square. Live music stage, food and mulled wine stalls, countdown on the giant LED screen, and a breathtaking midnight fireworks display launched from the Main River bridges. Tens of thousands gather to welcome the new year.
